mapper.insert: INSERT INTO share_summary_image_config ( id, enabled, auto_generate, provider_type, base_url, endpoint_path, api_key, model, image_size, quality, output_format, style_prompt, request_timeout_seconds, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{enabled}, #{autoGenerate}, #{providerType}, #{baseUrl}, #{endpointPath}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{imageSize}, #{quality}, #{outputFormat}, #{stylePrompt}, #{requestTimeoutSeconds}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = excluded.enabled, auto_generate = excluded.auto_generate, provider_type = excluded.provider_type, base_url = excluded.base_url, endpoint_path = excluded.endpoint_path, api_key = excluded.api_key, model = excluded.model, image_size = excluded.image_size, quality = excluded.quality, output_format = excluded.output_format, style_prompt = excluded.style_prompt, request_timeout_seconds = excluded.request_timeout_seconds, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO share_summary_image ( run_id, attempt_no, status, provider_type, model, image_size, output_format, quality, style_prompt_snapshot, prompt_snapshot, storage_key, public_token, image_url, og_image_url, og_page_url, og_title, og_description, raw_response_snapshot, error_message, duration_ms, created_at, started_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{providerType}, #{model}, #{imageSize}, #{outputFormat}, #{quality}, #{stylePromptSnapshot}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{storageKey}, #{publicToken}, #{imageUrl}, #{ogImageUrl}, #{ogPageUrl}, #{ogTitle}, #{ogDescription}, #{rawResponseSnapshot}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE share_summary_image SET status = #{status}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, og_image_url = #{ogImageUrl}, og_page_url = #{ogPageUrl}, raw_response_snapshot = #{rawResponseSnapshot}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM share_summary_image WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
